mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate indicates a monetary policy response to a deepening recession, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise) fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS declining), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates that the economy is responding to policy stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary easing cycles, the signal (INDPRO rising) fails to predict positive returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below the 12-month moving average signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 12-month MA, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakness in the consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST decline and RSAFS decline) fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
